10. REMOVE 2 APPLY GASKETS
p
11. REMOVE SHIFT SOLENOID VALVE
Remove the 5 bolts and 5 shift solenoid valves.
12. INSTALL SHIFT SOLENOID VALVE
Install the 5 shift solenoid valves with the 5 bolts.m Torque:
Bolt A: 6.6 N.m (67 kgf.cm, 58 ln.,lbf)
Bolt B: 11 N,m (110 kgf-cm, 8 ft,lbf)
Bolt length:
Bolt A: 14 mm (0.55 in.) p
Bolt B: 55 mm (2.17 In.)
13. INSTALL APPLY GASKET
(a) Coat 2 new apply gaskets with ATF.
(b) Install the gaskets to the transaxle case.
